column1: # Overlay list of where secret values live (F-secrets known-values scan; hookkit/knownvalues.ts).
# file: a glob of config files; values of secret-named keys (password, pwd, secret, token, key,
#       credential, auth) six characters or longer are the known values.
# env:  an environment variable whose value is a known value.
# The values stay in memory; a hit names file:line and the key, never the value.
